name: Tokekai
summary: Tokekai is a free 8x8 luminous quartz block puzzle for iPhone and iPad with no ads, no ad tracking, and no account required. It plays offline with auto-save in Endless mode and features a shared Daily Challenge where every player gets the same board each day. Online leaderboards verify every score by replaying moves on the server, with two rankings: All Runs (every player's best score) and Pure (runs with zero Sparks). Each of the six quartz spirits carries its own distinct geometric facet pattern so color is never the only visual cue.
